title: Air-conditioning for human comfort.
officialText:
Group A2, A3, B1, B2 and B3 refrigerants shall not be used in high-probability air conditioning systems for human comfort.
Exceptions:
1. Sealed absorption and unit air conditioning systems having refrigerant quantities not exceeding those set forth in Table 1104.3.1.
2. Industrial occupancies.

Nothing in this section shall be construed to allow the use of Group A3 and B3 refrigerants if otherwise prohibited.

Special Quanity Limits for Sealed Ammonia/Water Absorption and Self-Contained Systems
